title: Restricted Serialized DIVDRA Active Runtime Callsite Composition
goal: Activate the already qualified restricted DIVDRA runtime binding in the serialized production runtime without reopening drainage science or adding implicit drainage semantics.

design.request_layout: optional column-aligned compact request array with shared distribution-parameter and hydraulic-view registries
design.forcing_semantics: copy only the selected column forcing object, bind DIVDRA into that ephemeral copy, then execute the existing transaction path
design.shared_forcing_handle_policy: fail closed for an active DIVDRA request when its forcing handle is shared by another logical column
design.inactive_feature_cost: no drainage request arrays and no forcing copy when DIVDRA composition is absent

required_proofs: legacy serialized runtime path is unchanged when DIVDRA composition is absent
valid positive scalar transfer is distributed by the exact admitted F-MR33 binding before solver execution
zero transfer is admitted and publishes a zero row
negative or sub-threshold positive transfer fails closed before any solver or committed-state mutation
pre-existing drainage forcing is never silently overwritten
two distinct explicit hydraulic views produce their corresponding distinct node distributions
shared forcing handles cannot leak one column's drainage projection into another column
existing source/sink mass accounting consumes the prepared row exactly once
O0 and O2 runtime output is identical
all 30 SWAP architecture invariants have no adverse delta
hard_holds: no claim of trial-state or fully implicit drainage
no source/sink Jacobian or response tangent
no surface-water-controlled drainage; F-PM08D remains reserved for that scope
no parallel active DIVDRA callsite qualification in this workunit
no new mass tolerance or configurable mass-conservation concession
no I/O, calendar, MODFLOW-cell or tile-fraction assumption
